name: pdf-parser
description: Parse text, scanned, table-heavy, and image-rich PDFs into structured Markdown and JSON with a user-owned LlamaCloud key.

interface.shortDescription: Extract text, OCR, tables, and layout from PDFs.
interface.longDescription: Uses each user's own LlamaCloud API key to parse text-based, scanned, table-heavy, and image-rich PDFs into structured Markdown and JSON while preserving private raw evidence. Optional validators check question-and-answer deliverables.
interface.defaultPrompt: Parse this authorized PDF with my LlamaCloud key and return structured Markdown and JSON.
